name: base-blocked-unlock-pickup
task: Pick up the blocking ball and the key, in either order, unlock the door, and then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The clauses jointly express the task: Existence(door_open), Existence(target_picked_up), and Precedence chains (blocker_moved,door_open), (has_door_key,door_open), (door_open,target_picked_up) capture the ordered unlock and pickup; the two RespondedExistence clauses capture 'in either order' for ball and key. No Existence clauses for blocker_moved or has_door_key are needed since the Precedence chains with the hard Existence(door_open) already force both.

texts: If the blocker is moved, the key must also be acquired at some point or already have been acquired.
If the key is acquired, the blocker must also be moved at some point or already have been moved.
The door is not opened before the blocker has been moved.
The door is not opened before the key has been acquired.
The target box must be picked up.
The target box is not picked up before the door has been opened.
